newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPS REMAIN NEGATIVE, HEAD TOWARDS 134.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPS REMAIN NEGATIVE, HEAD TOWARDS 134.00.

text.p: LIFFE September BTP futures will maintain their negative stance on Friday despite forming a higher high on Thursday, technical analysts said.
Aidan Clare, head of bond and derivatives sales at Ulster Bank Markets in Dublin, said following a reversal week last week, BTPs would continue lower.
"Resistance from the 10- and 30-day moving averages at 136.43/136.31, allied with Fibonacci resistance at 136.03, should cap rises before losses to 134.00," he said.
A 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement of the move down from 138.13 on July 30 to 134.73 on August 6 comes in around 136.03.
At 0848 GMT, September BTP futures were at 135.08, down 0.56.
The contract ticked up to 136.19 on Thursday but then dropped to close at 135.64.
"The weak close confirms the underlying short covering of the recent bounce," said technical analysts at an Italian bank in London in a research note.
To the upside, they said the contract needed to break above Thursday's high.
"Only a concerted break of 136.19 could confirm a reverse head and shoulder formation on the hourly chart, with a projection to 136.60," they said.
September Eurolira futures were at 93.21, up one basis point on the day.
Analysts noted support at 93.18, 16, reflecting recent lows.
